tools.name: whats_on_in_city
tools.description: Contemporary art shows open now or opening soon in one city, from museums and galleries to project spaces. Looks 1 to 30 days ahead (default 14) and returns up to 20 shows, each with its dates, its space and a vernissage_url link to the show. Credit vernissage when you use them.

tools.name: resolve_art_entity
tools.description: Look up an artist, curator, space (gallery, museum or project space) or show by name. Returns a short profile: a few lines of bio, links to reference records elsewhere, up to 3 recent shows, counts of its shows and connections on the map, and a vernissage_url link to its full page. tools.name: find_artworks_by_meaning
tools.description: Describe a colour, a material, a mood, a subject or a motif and get up to 5 works from over a century of art history that match it, each with its artist, year, a thumbnail and a link to its page on vernissage. Also returns a link to see more results on the site.
